title: Topologically Protected Learning from Exceptional Point Braiding: Toward Braid Programming
summary: We present a framework for topological learning based on exceptional point (EP) braiding in a non-Hermitian Bogoliubov-de Gennes Hamiltonian. A closed algebraic equation for the EP super-surface is derived; through momentum quantisation in finite systems, it predicts the exact number and parameter positions of all EPs in real space, irrespective of system size. The EP topology is characterised by two quantised invariants the state-swap fidelity and the normalised Berry phase which cannot both be zero for a topological EP.
